audit.notes: Perfect format to recreate using existing lifestyle b-roll. You just need 12-14 short 1-2 second clips depicting everyday solitary moments (subway rides, making food, studying, walking at night, shopping) paired with bulleted relatable text points targeted at a specific identity (e.g., 'only people who moved to NYC alone can relate').
audit.summary: A montage of everyday relatable struggles of living abroad as an international student, set to a melancholic slowed soundtrack and paired with empathetic text lines.
